## Define Gene Sets
```{r}
Gene_Sets <- list()
# Poon NI 2023
xl <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Poonetal_SuppTable7_barrTRM_v_Other_DEGs.xlsx", sheet = 1)
xl <- xl[-1] 
xl_up <- xl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Tissue", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(JE|LG|SK)_(.*)"
  ) %>% subset(logfoldchang > 0.75 & pvals_adj < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(names) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(n_distinct(Tissue) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()  

xl_up <- unique(xl_up$names)
xl_up <- as.vector(na.omit(convert_human_to_mouse_symbols(xl_up)))
xl_up <- paste0(xl_up, "+")

xl_down <- xl %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Tissue", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(JE|LG|SK)_(.*)"
  ) %>% subset(logfoldchang < -0.75 & pvals_adj <0.05) %>%
  group_by(names) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(n_distinct(Tissue) >= 3) %>%
  ungroup()  
# The data have been subset to include significant genes only present in 2 or more organs

xl_down <- unique(xl_down$names)
xl_down <- as.vector(na.omit(convert_human_to_mouse_symbols(xl_down)))
xl_down <- paste0(xl_down, "-")

Poon_2023 <- c(xl_up, xl_down )
  

# Mackay 2016
Mackay_2016 <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_sig_Mackay2016_suppFig13.xlsx", sheet = 1)

# Scott 2025 - Genes_Up
Scott_2025_Icos <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_signature_Scott2025_Figure7.xlsx", sheet = 1)
Scott_2025_NoIcos <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_signature_Scott2025_Figure7.xlsx", sheet = 3)
Scott_2025_up <- unique(c(Scott_2025_Icos$Icoshi_Trm_up_genes, Scott_2025_NoIcos$Icoslo_Trm_up_genes))
Scott_2025_up <- paste0(Scott_2025_up, "+")

# Scott 2025 - Genes_Down
Scott_2025_Icos <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_signature_Scott2025_Figure7.xlsx", sheet = 2)
Scott_2025_NoIcos <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_signature_Scott2025_Figure7.xlsx", sheet = 4)
Scott_2025_down <- unique(c(Scott_2025_Icos$Icoshi_Trm_down_genes, Scott_2025_NoIcos$Icoslo_Trm_down_genes))
Scott_2025_down <- paste0(Scott_2025_down, "-")

Scott_2025 <- c(Scott_2025_up, Scott_2025_down)

# Jaiswal
Jaiswal_2022 <- read.xlsx("../data/TRM_Sig/Trm_sig_Jaiswal2022_supp1.xlsx", sheet = 1)
up <- c(Jaiswal_2022$Exclusive_high, Jaiswal_2022$non_exclusive_up )
up <- na.omit(up)
up <- as.vector(na.omit(convert_human_to_mouse_symbols(up)))



down <- subset(Jaiswal_2022, Exclusive_down != "NA")$Exclusive_down
down <- as.vector(na.omit(convert_human_to_mouse_symbols(down)))
Jaiswal_2022 <- c(paste0(up, "+"), paste0(down, "-") )
  
Gene_Sets[["Poon_2023"]] <- Poon_2023
Gene_Sets[["Jaiswal_2022"]] <- Jaiswal_2022
Gene_Sets[["Mackay_2016"]] <- Mackay_2016
Gene_Sets[["Scott_2025"]] <- Scott_2025

Other_Sets <- list()

# Utzschneider NAture Immunology 2020
xl <- read.xlsx("../../../../../My_Analysis/reference_data/Gene_Signatures/Utzschneider_NatImmunology_2020.xlsx", sheet = 5, startRow = 2)
Other_Sets[["TEX_Utzschneider_2020"]] <- as.vector(xl$Symbol)

Other_Sets[["TCR_Elliot_2021"]] <- as.vector(c("Nr4a1", "Nr4a2", "Nr4a3", "Cd69", "Tnf", "Irf4", "Irf8", "Egr2", "Tnfsf4", "Il2", "Il2ra", "Cd40lg", "Pdcd1", "Tbx21", "Ifng", "Gzmb", "Il12rb2", "Malt1", "Mt1", "Mt2", "Il21", "Rora", "Rorc", "Ctla4", "Icos", "Maf", "Il10", "Nfil3", "Tigit", "Lag3", "Cd3g", "Cd3e", "Lck", "Rasgrp1", "Gata3", "Bhlhe40", "Eomes", "Runx3"))
```

# Cluster Descriptions
```{r}
txt_pt <- 10                   # ONE size in points for all theme text
txt_mm <- txt_pt / 2.845  
```

```{r}
feat <- list(
    Lin = c("Cd4","Cd8a"),
    Naive = c("Ccr7", "Sell","Tcf7", "Klf2"),
    Activation = c("Cd44", "Cd69","Ifng", "Ccl5"),
    Cytotoxic = c( "Gzmb","Nkg7","Runx3"),
    Treg = c( "Foxp3","Il2ra", "Ctla4"),
    Proliferation = c( "Stmn1","Mki67", "Top2a"))

Dot <- seu_gene_sets_dot(Tc,
    feat,                         # named list: list("Group A"=c("G1","G2(+)"), "Group B"=c(...))
    group_by = "celltype",              # meta.data column (like DotPlot(group.by=))
    assay    = NULL,                   # NULL => DefaultAssay(seu)
    use_scaled_for_fill = TRUE,        # TRUE: fill = avg.exp.scaled; FALSE: avg.exp (raw)
    # aesthetics (DotPlot-like)
    size_range   = c(1, 5),           # bubble size range
    size_breaks  = c(5, 20, 40),  # % expressing
    size_limits  = c(0, 100),          # % expressing limits
    fill_limits  = c(-1, 1),           # when use_scaled_for_fill=TRUE
    fill_palette = c("blue", "lightgrey", "darkred"),
    x_label      = "",
    base_size    = txt_pt,
    x_angle      = 45,
    x_text_size  = txt_pt,
    y_text_size  = txt_pt,
    x_title_size = txt_pt,
    bracket_text_size = txt_mm,
    bracket_tick = 0.25,
    # layout/headroom controls
    y_expand_add_bottom = 0.60,        # add bottom padding (lifts dots off x-axis)
    y_expand_add_top    = 0.25,        # add top padding (reduces headroom)
    y_bracket_offset    = 0.80,        # bracket baseline above top row (in "row" units)
    y_label_offset      = 0.18,        # text above bracket baseline
    plot_margin_cm      = c(1.2, 0.6, 0.6, 0.6),  # top, right, bottom, left
    # NEW: clustering options
    cluster_groups = F,            # reorder rows (clusters) by hclut
    cluster_genes  = "within_group",
    dist_method    = "euclidean",
    hclust_method  = "complete") & theme(text = element_text(family = "Times"))


svglite("../docs/assets/05-Figure-5/cluster_data.svg", width = 7, height = 3)
Dot
invisible(dev.off())
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/05-Figure-5/cluster_data.svg")
```

#-----Venn of DEG------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
```{r}
Idents(Tc) <- "Tissue"
Spleen <- FindMarkers(Tc, ident.1 = "Spleen", min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 0.25, test.use = "MAST", only.pos = T)
Spleen <- subset(Spleen, p_val_adj < 0.05)
Stable <- FindMarkers(Tc, ident.1 = "Stable", min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 0.25, test.use = "MAST", only.pos = T)
Stable <- subset(Stable, p_val_adj < 0.05)
Unstable <- FindMarkers(Tc, ident.1 = "Unstable", min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 0.25, test.use = "MAST", only.pos = T)
Unstable <- subset(Unstable, p_val_adj < 0.05)
```

```{r}
groups <- c("Spleen", "Stable", "Unstable")

  groups       = groups,
  ident_col    = "Tissue",        # change if your column is called something else
  unique_groups= c("Spleen", "Stable", "Unstable"),
```

## HM
```{r, fig.height=18, fig.width=2.5, dpi = 300}
Idents(Tc) <- "Tissue"
Tc.Avg <- AverageExpression(Tc, assays = "RNA", slot = "scale.data", return.seurat = TRUE)
```

```{r}
Heatmap_Genes <- Unique_vs_Common_Graph %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(100, wt = avg_log2FC)
Heatmap_Genes$Num <- rownames(Heatmap_Genes)

mtx <- Tc.Avg@assays$RNA@layers$scale.data
mtx <- as.data.frame(mtx)
colnames(mtx) <- colnames(Tc.Avg)
rownames(mtx) <- rownames(Tc.Avg)
         
mtx_sub <-subset(mtx, rownames(mtx) %in% Heatmap_Genes$gene)
x <- Heatmap_Genes$gene
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub[, c(3,2,1)]
mtx_sub <- mtx_sub %>% arrange(factor(rownames(mtx_sub), levels = x))

meta <- Tc.Avg@meta.data
meta$cluster <- rownames(meta)
meta <- meta[c(3,2,1),]

# Set up annotations for rows and clusters
# genes you want to label
genes_to_label <- c(
  "Tcf7", "Sell", "Lef1", "Cd27",
  "Klrg1", "Il7r", "Stat4", "Itga4",
  "Tnf", "Klrk1", "Ly6e", "Il18r",
  "Gzmb", "Cd44", "Cd69", "Pdcd1", "Bhlhe40", "Icos", "Cxcr6", "Pdcd1", "Il18r", "Tnfrsf4", "Furin"
  
)   # <-- edit this

# find their row indices in the heatmap data
lab_idx <- which(Heatmap_Genes$gene %in% genes_to_label)

# sanity check (optional)
Heatmap_Genes$gene[lab_idx]

labels <- rowAnnotation(
  x = anno_mark(
    at = lab_idx,
    labels_rot = -30,
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt),
    padding = unit(1, "mm"),
    labels = Heatmap_Genes$gene[lab_idx],
    side = "left"
  )
)

cluster_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  cluster = meta$cluster,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_label = FALSE,
  annotation_name_rot = 5,
  show_legend = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0)),
  col = list(cluster = cols$Tissue[c(1,3,4)]
)
)

# Set up heatmap colors and legend
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-0.75, 0, 0.75), c("blue", "#EEEEEE", "red"))
heatmap_legend_params <- list(
  legend_direction = "horizontal",
  legend_width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = txt_pt),
  labels_rot = -90,
  title = "",
  title_gp = gpar(box_fill = "grey"),
  at = c(-1, 0, 1)
)

# Create row annotations using HeatmapAnnotation
right_annotation = rowAnnotation(anno = anno_block(gp = gpar(fill = cols$Tissue[c(1,3,4,5)]),
        labels = c("Spleen Unique", "Stable Unique", "Unstable Unique", "Plaque Common"), labels_gp = gpar(col = "white", fontsize = txt_pt), labels_rot = -90))

# Draw heatmap
Hm <- Heatmap(
  mtx_sub,
  height = nrow(mtx_sub)*unit(0.35, "mm"),
  width = ncol(mtx_sub)*unit(2.5, "mm"),
  border = TRUE,
  top_annotation = cluster_anno,
  right_annotation = right_annotation,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0),
  left_annotation = labels,
  col = col_fun,
  split = Heatmap_Genes$cluster,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
  column_names_side = NULL,
  row_title = " ",
  heatmap_legend_param = heatmap_legend_params)

svglite("../docs/assets/05-Figure-5/Tissue_Hm.svg", width = 3, height = 10)
draw(Hm, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
invisible(dev.off())
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/05-Figure-5/Tissue_Hm.svg")

```

#----Representation of Expanded CD8 T cells---
```{r}
Tc_TCR <- subset(Tc, Frequency > 0)

## Recalculate by GrossTissue
library(dplyr)

Tc_TCR@meta.data <- Tc_TCR@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
Exp = sub("^[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*$", "\\1", orig.ident)
  )

Tc_TCR <- recalculateFrequency(Tc_TCR, cloneCall = "gene", groupBy = "Exp")

## Overwrite Old Frequency
Tc_TCR$Frequency <- Tc_TCR$recalFrequency.Exp

table(Tc_TCR$cloneType)

## Reorder Points on Levels of TCR
slot(Tc_TCR, "meta.data")$cloneType <- factor(slot(Tc_TCR, "meta.data")$cloneType, levels = c(
"Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)",
"Large (0.01 < X <= 0.1)",
"Medium (0.001 < X <= 0.01)",
"Small (1e-04 < X <= 0.001)",
"Rare (0 < X <= 1e-04)",
"Single Clone", NA))

Tc_TCR$cloneSize <- Tc_TCR $cloneType

table(Tc_TCR$cloneSize)

levels(factor(Tc_TCR$recalFrequency.Exp))

## Assign Expanded vs Non-Expanded Label
Tc_TCR$Expanded <- Tc_TCR$Frequency
Idents(Tc_TCR) <- "Expanded"

Tc_TCR$Expanded <- ifelse(Tc_TCR$recalFrequency.Exp == "Single", "Single", "Expanded")
Tc_TCR$Expanded <- Tc_TCR$Expanded
```

##----Expanded vs. Not CD8 DEG----
```{r}
Idents(Tc_TCR) <- "Expanded"

Expanded_vs_Single <- FindMarkers(Tc_TCR, ident.1 = "Expanded", min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 0, only.pos = F, test.use = "MAST",
verbose = F)

Expanded_vs_Single$gene <- rownames(Expanded_vs_Single)
Expanded_vs_Single$Group <- ifelse(Expanded_vs_Single$avg_log2FC < 0, "Single", "Expanded")
```
```{r}
keyvals <- ifelse(Expanded_vs_Single$avg_log2FC < -0.25 & Expanded_vs_Single$p_val_adj < 0.01, "#00539CFF", ifelse(Expanded_vs_Single$avg_log2FC > 0.25 & Expanded_vs_Single$p_val_adj < 0.01, "#FFD662FF",
        'black'))
keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'black'
names(keyvals)[keyvals == '#FFD662FF'] <- 'Unstable'
names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'black'] <- ''
names(keyvals)[keyvals == '#00539CFF'] <- 'Stable'


 ExpandedVol <- EnhancedVolcano(Expanded_vs_Single,
    lab = Expanded_vs_Single$gene,
    caption = "",
    x = 'avg_log2FC',
    y = 'p_val_adj',
    title = "",
    subtitle = "",
    legendPosition = "none",
    FCcutoff = 0.25,
    pCutoff = 0.01,
    boxedLabels = T, pointSize = 4, labSize = 4,
    drawConnectors = T,
    selectLab = c("Gzmb", "Gzmk", "Pdcd1", "Cxcr6", "Tigit", "Tox", "Bhlhe40", "Runx3"),
colCustom = keyvals) + scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2.5, 3)) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 60)) +
  theme_pubr() + 
  NoLegend() + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
  text = element_text(family = "Times"),      
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = txt_pt), 
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = txt_pt), 
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = txt_pt), 
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = txt_pt),
plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = txt_pt + 4)) +
```

#-----CD8 Exhaustion------ {.tabset .tabset-pills .tabset-fade}
## TEX_Umap
```{r}
DefaultAssay(Tc) <- "RNA"

# Define the genes and threshold
genes <- c("Tox", "Icos", "Pdcd1", "Lag3", "Irf4", "Il21r", "Faslg")
thr   <- 0.75

# CD8 genes (mouse)
cd8_genes <- c("Cd8a", "Cd8b1")

# Keep only genes that exist in the object
genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(Tc))
if (!"Tox" %in% genes_present) stop("Tox not found in Tc")

cd8_present <- intersect(cd8_genes, rownames(Tc))
if (length(cd8_present) == 0) stop("Neither Cd8a nor Cd8b1 found in Tc")

# Get expression (scaled)
expr <- GetAssayData(Tc, assay = "RNA", slot = "scale.data")[genes_present, , drop = FALSE]

# TOX expression per cell
tox_expr <- expr["Tox", ]

# Other exhaustion genes
other_genes <- setdiff(genes_present, "Tox")

# How many of the *other* genes are > threshold per cell
other_count <- colSums(expr[other_genes, , drop = FALSE] > thr)

# CD8 gate (CD8a OR CD8b1 must be expressed)
cd8_expr <- GetAssayData(Tc, assay = "RNA", slot = "scale.data")[cd8_present, , drop = FALSE]
cd8_ok   <- colSums(cd8_expr > thr) >= 0.75

# Cells: TOX > thr AND at least 3 of the others > thr AND CD8a/b1 > thr
sel <- tox_expr > thr & other_count >= 3 & cd8_ok

Tex_cells <- colnames(Tc)[sel]

# Add to metadata
Tc$TEX <- ifelse(colnames(Tc) %in% Tex_cells, "TEX", "Other")

# Extract UMAP coordinates and metadata
umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(Tc, "umap"))
umap_df$cell      <- rownames(umap_df)
umap_df$highlight <- Tc$TEX

library(ggtext)
library(ggplot2)

Tex_fplot <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(umap_df, highlight == "Other"),
    color = "lightgrey",
    size  = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(umap_df, highlight == "TEX"),
    aes(fill = highlight),
    shape = 21,
    size  = 2,
    stroke = 0.3,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TEX" = "#edbe2a")) +
  theme_void() +
  ggtitle("T<sub>EX</sub>") +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    text = element_text(family = "Times"),
    plot.title = element_markdown(
      size   = 40,
      hjust  = 0.5,
      face   = "bold",
      color  = "#edbe2a",
      margin = margin(b = 10),
      lineheight = 5
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

svglite("../docs/assets/05-Figure-5/TEX_fplot.svg", width = 3, height = 4)
print(Tex_fplot)
invisible(dev.off())
knitr::include_graphics("../docs/assets/05-Figure-5/TEX_fplot.svg")
```

## Representation of TEX per Tissue
```{r}
df <- Tc@meta.data  %>%
  dplyr::count(Tissue, TEX) %>%              # count combinations
  group_by(Tissue) %>%                      # within each celltype
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%      # calculate %
  ungroup()

TEX_Percent <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Tissue, y = percent, fill = Tissue)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.9, color = "black") +
  labs(y = expression(Percent~T[EX]),
       fill = "Cluster") +
  theme_pubr(base_family = "Times") +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 2,
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.title = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = txt_pt),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title.x = element_blank()   # remove x-axis title
  ) + scale_fill_manual(values = cols$Tissue[2:4]) + ylim(c(0,5)) + NoLegend()
```
